pages.title: Farm Blast 2
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Tap neighboring groups of fruit in Farm Blast 2 to clear them. Check the level's targets before spending a move, since you may need to rescue animals or get through an obstacle. Clear a larger group when you can to create a booster for a later move.

pages.title: Blue Hedgehog Hill Dash Ride
pages.creator: Todos For Games
pages.description: Ride with the blue hedgehog across rough hills and lunar terrain in Blue Hedgehog Hill Dash Ride. Accelerate on the approach and lean forward or back to balance the vehicle in the air. Adjust your angle before landing so you can keep moving toward the finish.

pages.title: Cat Life Simulator: Devil Cat
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Roam Grandma's house from a cat's point of view in Cat Life Simulator: Devil Cat. Scratch walls, break items, and knock furniture over to earn points. Explore the rooms to see what the cat can reach and how much of a mess it can make.

pages.title: Minecraft Battle Party
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Take on rivals in Minecraft Battle Party, a block-style arena fighter. Try different roles and weapons, such as a gunner who attacks enemies within range. Keep moving to bring opponents into range while avoiding their attacks.

pages.title: ASMR Tattoo Treatment
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Treat a rocker's piercing and tattoo in ASMR Tattoo Treatment. Choose the tools the clinic shows you to care for the sore piercing, then touch up the fading star. Follow the treatment sequence and listen to the sounds as each step is completed.

pages.title: Komaru cat
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Feed, pet, bathe, and tuck in Komaru in Komaru cat. Dress her with hats, glasses, or collars, and try a different fur color. Earn coins from daily tasks and the merge mini-game, or watch clips of Komaru between care activities.

pages.title: Animal Block Pop Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Drag animal-shaped blocks into the grid in Animal Block Pop Puzzle. Group at least three matching tiles to clear them, and set off consecutive blasts for bonus points. Use items such as bombs or rockets as the board gets faster and new colors appear.

pages.title: Happy Color
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Hold to guide a hammer over colored tiles in Happy Color. Smash the blocks to clear the layout and move on to the next puzzle. Upgrade the hammer for different designs and effects as you take on more complicated boards.

pages.title: Bubble Mania Shooter
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Clear bubbles in Bubble Mania Shooter while trying to use as few shots as possible. Aim for groups that open up the board and use a power-up when a tough bubble stands in the way. Fewer shots help you earn more stars.

pages.title: Unblock Ball Slide Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Slide blocks to build a channel in Unblock Ball Slide Puzzle. Check which direction each piece of the route faces before you move it. Connect the starting point to the finish so the ball can roll through without hitting a break in the path.

pages.title: Quackventure
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Guide Quack through a magical forest in Quackventure while a giant purple monster pursues him. Use WASD and Space to get around obstacles, and collect power-ups along the way. Look for a clear route ahead when the chase closes in.

pages.title: Hardventure
pages.creator: Mao Games
pages.description: Get a little ninja through hidden traps in Hardventure. Watch for collapsing floors, spikes, and bumpers that change the direction of a jump. Each world has its own layout, so read the next landing before you commit to it.

pages.title: Cars Merge
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description: Buy cars and merge matching ones in Cars Merge. Put them on the track to earn coins while they race, then reinvest those coins in more cars. Keep combining the ones you have to discover the next vehicle in the collection.

pages.title: Mustang City Driver
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Drive a customizable Mustang through city traffic in Mustang City Driver. Watch your fuel and keep clear of pedestrians, since hitting one can bring the police after you. Try the four modes, change the car's appearance or performance, and use nitro when you have a clear stretch.

pages.title: Best Classic Freecell Solitaire
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Move cards into suit piles from ace to king in Best Classic Freecell Solitaire. All cards are visible from the start, so look ahead before moving a sequence. Save the free cells for cards that need to get out of the way temporarily.

pages.title: My Perfect Organization
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Work through a collection of home-organizing puzzles in My Perfect Organization. Sort items and find places for them as you tidy up different areas of the house. Each activity changes what needs to be packed or arranged.

pages.title: Color Sort Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Move the top bubbles from one flask to another in Color Sort Mania. Put bubbles of each color together in a single flask to clear the level. Plan where to store a bubble that is in the way and use a power-up when space gets tight.

pages.title: Las Vegas Poker
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Play Texas Hold'em in Las Vegas Poker. Use your two private cards and the shared cards to make your strongest five-card hand. Match the current bet to stay in the round, and take on the tournaments to work toward a new avatar.

pages.title: DOP Puzzle: Displace One Part
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Complete cartoon scenes in DOP Puzzle: Displace One Part. Drag the supplied pieces into the picture and use the scene to work out where they belong. Some solutions depend on the order in which you place the pieces, and some items can be left unused.

pages.title: Merge Grabber
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Recruit characters as you move through Merge Grabber. Slide to steer your group toward more recruits and build up its firepower. Keep adding to the team before it comes up against the enemy.

pages.title: Emoji Puzzle
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Pair pictures by meaning in Emoji Puzzle. Look across the columns for emojis that share an idea, then select them to draw a connection. Use the theme of each pair to work out which symbols belong together.

pages.title: Candy Plus Candy
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Move candies toward matching pieces in Candy Plus Candy. Form a line of three of the same kind to remove them, then check what matches the new layout makes possible. Clear the candies sooner to earn a higher score.

pages.title: Insect Exploration
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Guide creatures such as snails, spiders, and grasshoppers through Insect Exploration. Use jumps, flights, and bounces to work through the layouts. Look at what each creature can do before choosing how to reach the next part of the level.

pages.title: Deads On The Road
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Escape down a dark road in Deads On The Road while zombies close in. Steer and change speed to get past threats, then fire or swing the katana when they get too close. See how many meters you can cover before the undead catch you.

pages.title: Emoji Flow
pages.creator: tiplay studio
pages.description: Join identical faces in Emoji Flow by drawing a path between each pair. Keep the paths from crossing and work out how to cover the grid before your moves run out. Leave room for the last pair when you draw the first few lines.

pages.title: Bro draw it
pages.creator: Nanjing maileyou Network Technology Co., Ltd
pages.description: Draw a single continuous line through the squares in Bro draw it. Follow the required figure without lifting your stroke before it is complete. Plan where to start so the route can reach the remaining parts without a break.

pages.title: Fruits Link Match3
pages.creator: VodoGame
pages.description: Swipe through neighboring pieces of the same fruit in Fruits Link Match3. Link at least three to clear them and make room for the next chain. Look at what each board needs and try to finish quickly.

pages.title: 2 Player Battle Car Racing
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Race a friend and use pickups in 2 Player Battle Car Racing. Grab nitro, shields, rockets, or other items along the route and choose when to use them. Keep control of the car while watching for whatever the other driver leaves in your path.

pages.title: Magic Lines
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Move colored balls into lines of five or more in Magic Lines. Rows, columns, and diagonals all count. Keep open cells available and use an undo, hammer, or bomb when the board gets crowded. Spin the Lucky Wheel for extra items.

pages.title: Starship Defender
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Pilot a starship through enemy lasers in Starship Defender. Shoot down invaders and look out for abduction ships trying to take scientists. Make those ships a priority while staying clear of the shots crossing your route.

pages.title: Happy Farm The Crop
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Harvest fruit and vegetables in Happy Farm The Crop by finding matching pairs of tiles. Clear the produce that goes together and look for another pair in the space it opens. The farm setting changes as you move through the levels.

pages.title: Adventure Joystick
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Help a little joystick reach the door in Adventure Joystick. Collect ores and find the key along the way. Use WASD or the touch controls to work around walls and hazards, since hitting an obstacle can send you back.

pages.title: Squid Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Put together pictures in Squid Jigsaw by dragging pieces into position. Play one of three difficulty settings and earn in-game money to unlock more of the ten images. Harder boards pay more when you finish them.

pages.title: Uphill Rush 9
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Ride horses, ponies, and unicorns through farm villages and western towns in Uphill Rush 9. Jump along the routes and aim for three stars across 20 levels. Unlock outfits and try other rides when you want a change from your current mount.

pages.title: Gemz!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Match the gems on each board in Gemz! Think ahead as you move pieces, since new obstacles can appear after a few turns. Change your plan when an obstacle interrupts a route to the next match.

pages.title: Shoot Blast
pages.creator: SNSHUB
pages.description: Aim a turret at incoming squares in Shoot Blast. Track where the blocks are heading and fire before they reach you. Keep adjusting your aim as new targets appear and see how long you can keep the turret going.

pages.title: Kingdom Defense Chaos Time
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Protect your castle from waves of monsters in Kingdom Defense Chaos Time. Earn gold from defeated enemies and spend it on stronger defenses or new castles. Upgrade your general skills as the waves get tougher across more than 50 levels.

pages.title: Micro Golf Ball 2
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Get golf balls into the holes in Micro Golf Ball 2. Use portals and springs to reach spots a direct shot cannot, and watch how light sources change the ball's color. Work around boxes and other obstacles as you plan each stroke.

pages.title: Red Square Adventure
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide a red square through platforming levels in Red Square Adventure. Steer around obstacles and use the double jump when one leap is too short. Watch where the square will come down as you work toward the end of each stage.

pages.title: Golf Solitaire
pages.creator: ConteZero
pages.description: Clear the tableau in Golf Solitaire by taking an exposed card one rank above or below the top waste card. Only the top card of a column is available. Look at which card a move will uncover before choosing between two useful plays.

pages.title: Call of Tanks
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Drag tank cards into the deployment area in Call of Tanks. Send units that can support one another and watch how the opposing force responds. Upgrade your tanks and defenses, then unlock stronger bases as you work through battles.

pages.title: Arkadium's Majongg Dark Dimensions 210 seconds
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Rotate the stacked tiles and look for identical pairs in Arkadium's Majongg Dark Dimensions 210 seconds. Match the time-bonus tiles to keep the clock running. Check another side when the visible tiles offer no match, and work quickly to clear the layout.

pages.title: Join Clash Epic Battle
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Gather more runners in Join Clash Epic Battle before meeting the enemy at the end. Drag to guide the group around hazards and pick up people along the route. Keep as many recruits as you can for the final fight.

pages.title: Dr Panda Daycare
pages.creator: Dr. Panda LTD
pages.description: Look after young animals in Dr Panda Daycare. Click or drag objects to play with the babies, help them settle for a nap, or throw a birthday party. Try the different activities as you move through the daycare.

pages.title: Doll House Games Design and Decoration
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Arrange furniture and decorations in Doll House Games Design and Decoration. Choose what to put in each part of the dollhouse and try different arrangements with the mouse. Move things around until the rooms fit the home you want to make.

pages.title: Stack Fall 3D: Crazy Mode
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Drop a ball down a stack in Stack Fall 3D: Crazy Mode. Time when you send it through the layers and watch for unsafe sections as the stack turns. Work your way down through the changing layouts without losing the ball.

pages.title: Pixel GunGame Arena Prison Multiplayer
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Join multiplayer battles or take on up to 40 offline levels in Pixel GunGame Arena Prison Multiplayer. Try five game modes and customize weapons with camouflage or attachments. Move through the block-built arena and switch guns as the fight changes.

pages.title: Mineblox Apple Shooter
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Shoot the apple in Mineblox Apple Shooter without hitting Steve. Adjust your aim before you release the arrow and watch where it travels. If a shot strikes Steve, the game ends, so make the next attempt with a different angle.

pages.title: Pong Football
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Defend your goal with a paddle in Pong Football and send the ball back toward the other side. Move with the mouse to meet the ball as it comes toward you. Score five times before your opponent to win.

pages.title: Math Tasks True or False
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Check whether the displayed equation is correct in Math Tasks True or False. Choose true when the result matches your calculation and false when it does not. Read each problem quickly before answering the next one.

pages.title: Coronavirus Fight
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Face another player in Coronavirus Fight, a real-time duel about fighting virus strains. Use the mouse or tap to make your moves as the contest unfolds. Watch the play area and react while the other side is making its own choices.

pages.title: Airplane Fly 3D Flight Plane
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Take off, fly through rings, and land at the destination in Airplane Fly 3D Flight Plane. Use the throttle to manage speed and follow the marked route before lining up the approach. Give yourself time to turn as you head toward each ring.

pages.title: Slapsies
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Challenge a friend to a hand-slapping contest in Slapsies. Use the mouse to time a slap when you are attacking and pull away when the other player is about to strike. Both players share the same device.

pages.title: Chained Cars 3D Impossible Driving
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Drive two linked cars through stunt routes in Chained Cars 3D Impossible Driving. Steer with the arrows or WASD and watch how the other car moves as you approach a turn or jump. Keep both cars moving together through the course.

pages.title: Ice Cream Rain
pages.creator: Mabno
pages.description: Catch falling scoops in Ice Cream Rain by dragging the cone beneath them. Read the customer's order first, since the scoops have to land in the requested sequence. Serve the cone and earn enough points to move on to the next level.

pages.title: Mini Bowling 3D
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Aim the ball at the pins in Mini Bowling 3D and send it down the lane with the mouse. Look at which pins are still standing and line up the next throw. Try to knock them all down with a clean strike.

pages.title: Christmas Eve Kissing
pages.creator: Gamer Games
pages.description: Help a couple share a kiss during a holiday party in Christmas Eve Kissing. Watch the people nearby and keep them occupied so the couple has a moment alone. Pick your moment when the guests are looking elsewhere.

pages.title: Asian Riddles
pages.creator: PlayToMax
pages.description: Use number clues to fill cells in Asian Riddles. Compare the clues for rows and columns to see where a square can be filled. Build up the solution one line at a time and use the intersections to resolve the spaces you were unsure about.

pages.title: R.O.B.O.Y. Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Match robot pictures in R.O.B.O.Y. Memory. Flip tiles and remember what each one showed when the pictures differ. Clear every pair across four levels and try to reduce the number of turns you need.

pages.title: Pirate Defender Shooting
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Help pirates follow a treasure map in Pirate Defender Shooting. Fight off the undead on the island and keep the route clear as the pirates look for the treasure. Use the mouse to take on the enemies in their way.

pages.title: Princess Chic Trends
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Emma, Bonnie, and Belle put together chic looks in Princess Chic Trends. Choose outfits, decorate their room to suit the style, and take pictures of the result. Finish by posting the photos to their fashion blog.

pages.title: Bouncy Ball
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Guide a bouncing ball from platform to platform in Bouncy Ball. Click and swipe to adjust its direction while it moves, and aim for the next surface before the ball falls. See how many platforms you can pass in the endless run.

pages.title: Run Santa Run
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Collect presents while running in Run Santa Run. Jump with the Up arrow and use E to hit monsters with Santa's sack. Press Space to throw a bomb when you need to clear an enemy ahead.

pages.title: Drift Rush 3D
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Customize a supercar and take it onto the track in Drift Rush 3D. Race for position, steer through a slalom, deal with traffic, or collect coins. Earn stars across the courses and use them to unlock more cars.

pages.title: Finger Family Song
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Drag family members onto a large hand in Finger Family Song. Place the characters on the fingers and follow the song as the family comes together. Use the activity to get familiar with the lyrics while you match the characters to their places.

pages.title: Vegas City Highway Bus Parking Simulator
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Park a bus in a Vegas-themed city in Vegas City Highway Bus Parking Simulator. Use WASD to drive and Space to brake as you approach the bay. Change the camera if you need a better view of the space around the bus.

pages.title: 4 Pics 1 Word
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Look for one word that connects four pictures in 4 Pics 1 Word. Compare the scenes for an object, action, or idea they share. Enter the answer to unlock the next puzzle and try the more difficult sets.

pages.title: The Driver Of A Mining Truck
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Carry heavy materials along mountain roads in The Driver Of A Mining Truck. Load the truck and take the cargo to the destination station. Slow down where the road bends and switch camera views when you need to judge the truck's position.

pages.title: Pro Cricket Champion
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Time your bat swing in Pro Cricket Champion so it meets the ball cleanly. Watch each delivery and avoid committing before you can judge its approach. Keep putting together good hits as the challenge gets harder.

pages.title: Shark Hunter2
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Fight off sharks in Shark Hunter2 before time runs out. Move through the area and use the mouse to aim and fire. Switch weapons with the scroll wheel and use the zoom when you need a closer view of a target.

pages.title: Industry Road Construction
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Work on city roads in Industry Road Construction. Use heavy machinery to clear old sections and build the new route. Drive the vehicles with WASD and choose machinery that suits the task at the construction site.

pages.title: SL Roadster Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble six pictures of an SL roadster in SL Roadster Puzzle. Choose a layout with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Follow details such as the bodywork or wheels to work out which pieces meet.

pages.title: Cute Pony Coloring Book
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Pick a pony picture and color it in Cute Pony Coloring Book. Choose shades for the larger areas and try contrasting colors on the smaller details. Take a screenshot when you finish if you want to keep or share the result.

pages.title: Monkey Kingdom Empire
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Guide a monkey through the platforming stages in Monkey Kingdom Empire. Look at the gaps and obstacles before deciding when to jump. Work through the sections one at a time and aim for a safe landing before the next challenge.

pages.title: Panda Commander Air Combat
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Fly a fighter jet in Panda Commander Air Combat. Watch for invading planes and line up shots to protect your territory. Keep maneuvering as enemies enter the battle and clear them before they get through.

pages.title: Up Lift
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Climb one tier at a time in Up Lift. Use the one-touch control when the next level is clear and watch the square enemies before moving. Try to keep climbing without getting caught.

pages.title: Cartoon Motorbikes Memory
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Turn over cards to find matching motorbike pictures in Cartoon Motorbikes Memory. Remember where each bike appeared when the cards do not match. Pick from four game modes and clear the whole layout by pairing every picture.

pages.title: Paint Hit
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Fire balls filled with paint at rotating rings in Paint Hit. Aim for unpainted sections and wait if the part in front of you already has color. Cover the ring without hitting a painted spot, since a repeat hit restarts the game.

pages.title: Fabulous Fashionista Dress up
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Put together an outfit in Fabulous Fashionista Dress up. Try dresses or combine tops and bottoms, then choose shoes and accessories to suit the look. Check how many likes and loves the finished outfit gets before trying another style.

pages.title: Animal Shapes
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Build animal pictures from geometric pieces in Animal Shapes. Compare the edges of each piece with the spaces in the picture and put it where it fits. Work through the puzzles by looking for differences in the shapes.

pages.title: Stickman School Run
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Run through a school-themed obstacle course in Stickman School Run. Help the stick figure get away from his homework and reach his girlfriend. Watch for obstacles as the route comes into view and time your moves to get through them.

pages.title: Popstar Drees Up
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Choose a stage outfit in Popstar Drees Up. Try clothes and accessories on a pop star and see how the look comes together before the performance. Change individual pieces until the outfit is ready for the stage.

pages.title: Swipe Basketball
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Swipe the ball toward the hoop in Swipe Basketball. Adjust the direction of the swipe as you line up each shot and look for chances to earn bonus points. A miss costs a ball, so make each attempt count.

pages.title: A Pixel Adventure Vol 2
pages.creator: Crimson Games IO
pages.description: Explore a monster-filled castle in A Pixel Adventure Vol 2. Guide the hero through 40 levels and look for places that are easy to miss on the main route. Watch for monsters while you search the rooms and work deeper into the castle.

pages.title: Wordoku
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Solve letter grids in Wordoku, a variation on Sudoku. Use the given letters to work out what belongs in each row, column, and box. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard and use the clues from crossing lines when a square has more than one possibility.

pages.title: Labrador at the Doctor Salon
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Care for a Labrador in Labrador at the Doctor Salon. Clean its teeth and ears, then work through a spa treatment for its coat. Follow each step as you switch from checking the dog's health to grooming its fur.
